resources.string: Reads accessible text of ONE app you selected, read-only, to test whether offer details are visible. Never taps or changes anything.

Read-only feasibility probe. It only reads the accessible text tree of the single app you selected in Offer Collector, redacts it on the device (names, addresses, phone numbers and free text are removed before saving) and never performs clicks, gestures or overlays. You can stop it at any time from the app or from this screen.
